{{short description|American mathematician}}
'''Jon T. Pitts''' (1948–2024)<ref>{{Cite web |title=Jon T. Pitts Obituary 2024 |url=https://www.hillierfuneralhome.com/obituaries/jon-pitts |access-date=2024-06-08 |website=Hillier Funeral Home & Cremations |language=en}}</ref> was an American [[mathematician]] who worked on [[geometric analysis]] and [[variational calculus]]. He was a professor at [[Texas A&M University]].

Pitts was born on 10 January 1948.<ref name="princeton">{{cite web | title=Jon T. Pitts *74 &#124; Princeton Alumni Weekly | url=https://paw.princeton.edu/memorial/jon-t-pitts-74 }}</ref> Pitts obtained his Ph.D. from [[Princeton University]] in 1974 under the supervision of [[Frederick Almgren|Frederick Almgren, Jr.]], with the thesis ''Every Compact Three-Dimensional Manifold Contains Two-Dimensional Minimal Submanifolds''.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=17342}}</ref><ref>{{OCLC|39101117}}</ref>

He received a [[Sloan Fellowship]] in 1981.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.sloan.org/sloan-research-fellowships/past-fellows/?tx_sloangrants_sloanfellows%5Bpage%5D=65&tx_sloangrants_sloanfellows%5BlastPage%5D=188&tx_sloangrants_sloanfellows%5Bsortby%5D=2&tx_sloangrants_sloanfellows%5Border%5D=2&tx_sloangrants_sloanfellows%5Bsearch%5D=&tx_sloangrants_sloanfellows%5Bcontroller%5D=Fellows&cHash=767d61f4d048e9cc78ee91b7c787ed4a |title=Past Fellows |publisher=Sloan.org |date=2012-07-18 |accessdate=2015-05-16 |archive-date=2015-07-13 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150713183145/http://www.sloan.org/sloan-research-fellowships/past-fellows/?tx_sloangrants_sloanfellows%5Bpage%5D=65&tx_sloangrants_sloanfellows%5BlastPage%5D=188&tx_sloangrants_sloanfellows%5Bsortby%5D=2&tx_sloangrants_sloanfellows%5Border%5D=2&tx_sloangrants_sloanfellows%5Bsearch%5D=&tx_sloangrants_sloanfellows%5Bcontroller%5D=Fellows&cHash=767d61f4d048e9cc78ee91b7c787ed4a |url-status=dead }}</ref>

The [[Almgren–Pitts min-max theory]] is named after his teacher and him.<ref>{{cite arXiv|eprint=1312.0792|title=A Note on the Geometry of Positively-Curved Riemannian Manifolds |author=Yashar Memarian |class=math.MG |year=2013 }}</ref>

Pitts died on 30 May 2024.<ref name="princeton" /><ref>"[https://paw.princeton.edu/sites/default/files/2024-11/Dec2024_issue.pdf "JON T. PITTS *74"]" ''[[Princeton Alumni Weekly]]'', December 2024, p. 77.</ref>

==Selected publications==
*''Existence and regularity of minimal surfaces on Riemannian manifolds''. Vol. 27. Mathematical Notes. Princeton, NJ; University of Tokyo Press, Tokyo: Princeton University Press, 1981, pp. iv+330. {{ISBN|0-691-08290-1}}.
*"Applications of minimax to minimal surfaces and the topology of 3-manifolds"
*"Existence of minimal surfaces of bounded topological type in three-manifolds"
